none_by_construction.arg: each NONE question names a CALLER (resolve() or _refuse()) and a callee that the body provably never invokes: resolve() body calls {block,encode,enumerated,get,record_resolution,resolved_count} (no record_refusal); _refuse() body calls {record_refusal} only (no resolved_count, no block). The plausible wrong answer exists one frame down (resolve() reaches record_refusal via _refuse at L155), which is exactly why the id is a discrimination test rather than a freebie

delta_v7_v8.note: fixture_version and supersedes.* are outside the treatment allow-list but are also not among the five forbidden surfaces (checkpoint id, expected value, turn, system_prompt, answer contract); they are version/self-description metadata, and supersedes.sha256 correctly names v7's 42b4df00...

findings: F1 (carried from V-FIXTURE-V7, still true of v8): value elision is the false-positive surface, not name subsetting - cp.0.t06 elides 2 of 5 kwarg values (bytes_appended, entry_text) and cp.11.t46 elides 1 of 3 (scope, the value that distinguishes scope=scope_name from scope=scope.name). An arm that names callee + all kwarg names but writes '...' for values passes those ids

F2 (carried): the two CALL expected strings are in source order, not the contract's alphabetical order, and cp.11.t46 appends ', before re-raising'; order and the suffix are ungraded by grade_v5, so this is documentation drift rather than a truth error

F3 (new, v8-specific): the top-level wall_tokens=3838 is admitted in wall_tokens_basis.transcript-compact_v5_era to be 10 tokens BELOW v8's own first prompt (3848), so on v8 it fires at T2 and compacts a transcript that never fit. The live grading wall is wall_tokens_by_arm=10616 for all four arms, so this only matters if a runner reads the top-level field
can_800_be_graded: Yes - 800 requests can be graded against v8's twelve truths: all 12 are independently reproduced from unchanged source, the checkpoint layer is byte-identical to the v7 layer that ATTACK-GRADE-V5-2 and V-FIXTURE-V7 passed, and the only delta is the treatment layer RUN-A* varies by design
